summary.intent: Fix grpc/grpc-go#7365: two concurrent addrConn.connect() calls could both observe Idle and both start connection attempts, orphaning a transport. The change keeps ac.mu held from connect()'s Idle check through the Connecting transition by turning resetTransport into resetTransportAndUnlock.
summary.issue_fit: Met. connect() and updateAddrs() now enter resetTransportAndUnlock with ac.mu held, so the Idle-to-Connecting transition is atomic with the check and a second connect() sees Connecting. The 100000-run flake measurement is reported by the author and not reproducible here.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (clientconn.go, +6/-7) reviewed with callers, transport onClose/GracefulClose and the balancer serializer. Focused tests run once at the head with -race: Test/ResetConnectBackoff, Test/UpdateAddresses_NoopIfCalledWithSameAddresses, Test/WithConnectParams and Test/ConnectParamsWithMinConnectTimeout passed. No added or changed tests, so none to inspect. Two concurrency safety premises were verified in one batch and both hold. No supplied CI checks; the packet's 18 prior review submissions and discussion were read as intent evidence only.

observations.fact: Commit 6214c9dd's message says it makes resetBackoff() callers lock the mutex, but the net range diff contains no such change and touches only clientconn.go's connect, updateAddrs and resetTransport.

requirements.source: spec-pr7390-review-packet/pr-body/"no concurrent requests are able to start once caller of `resetTransport` does some validation and calls `resetTransport`"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:906-923 keeps ac.mu held from the Idle check into resetTransportAndUnlock; clientconn.go:1261 sets Connecting before clientconn.go:1262 unlocks; a second connect() returns at the non-Idle check.
The window between connect()'s Unlock and resetTransport's Lock (base clientconn.go:918-1238) is removed; verifier ruled premise-connect-single-critical-section holds.

requirements.source: spec-pr7390-review-packet/pr-body/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: Author-reported measurement over 100000 runs on a forge; not repeatable offline within the five-minute allowance, and nothing material to the decision depends on it.

requirements.source: spec-pr7390-review-packet/pr-body/"RELEASE NOTES: client: fix race that could lead to orphaned connections"
requirements.evidence: The change removes the race that orphaned a second transport per the issue's root-cause comment.

tasks.premise: connect()'s Idle check and Connecting transition share one ac.mu critical section; the early acCtx.Err() return leaves state as before the change.
updateAddrs now returns with ac.mu held for the spawned goroutine; the deferred GracefulClose's onClose waits on ac.mu but the goroutine's path to Unlock never waits on anything GracefulClose holds.
